rationale: The opt-in Shipyard mac lane's macOS configure stage now ends with tools/ci/install_visual_python_deps.sh build, the same script build.yml and the sanitizer jobs already call, so the non-skippable visual-python-deps-present ctest can pass on that lane. The installed set (tools/motion/visual/requirements.lock), its hash pinning and the interpreter resolution are unchanged; the step test pins the new caller. No visual harness fixture, golden, threshold, capture path, renderer, importer or Vellum-owned source changes, and no design-import, Chromium, rendering or packaging authority moves.
